context.person: A person using a mobile banking application
context.journey_stage: ATM cash not dispensed but debit pending
context.user_goal: Wait for review before attempting another withdrawal for the same cash need.

product_state.preceding_state: An ATM session ended without dispensing cash, but a withdrawal is pending on the account.
product_state.current_state: No cash was dispensed. A $100 withdrawal is pending.
known_facts: The bank will review the ATM record within two business days.
A new withdrawal could reduce the available balance again.
forbidden_claims: The money has already been returned.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand atm cash not dispensed but debit pending, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View the pending withdrawal and review timeline.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Report the issue if it becomes completed or remains pending after two business days.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The account balance and withdrawal outcome are not final.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Wait for review before attempting another withdrawal for the same cash need.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
